","role":"assistant","tool_calls":[{"function":{"arguments":"{"command": "create", "path": "/app/workspace/extract.py", "file_text": "\"\"\"Extract date and total amount from receipt images and write to Excel.\"\"\"\nimport os\nimport re\nimport pytesseract\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageOps\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\n\nIMG_DIR = \"/app/workspace/dataset/img\"\nOUT_PATH = \"/app/workspace/stat_ocr.xlsx\"\n\n# Priority-ordered keyword groups (higher priority searched first)\nKEYWORD_GROUPS = [\n    [\"GRAND TOTAL\"],\n    [\"TOTAL RM\", \"TOTAL: RM\"],\n    [\"TOTAL AMOUNT\"],\n    [\"TOTAL DUE\", \"AMOUNT DUE\", \"BALANCE DUE\", \"NETT TOTAL\", \"NET TOTAL\",\n     \"TOTAL\", \"AMOUNT\"],\n]\n\nEXCLUSION_KEYWORDS = [\n    \"SUBTOTAL\", \"SUB TOTAL\", \"TAX\", \"GST\", \"SST\", \"DISCOUNT\",\n    \"CHANGE\", \"CASH TENDERED\",\n]\n\n# Numbers like 1,234.56 or 12.34 (require decimal part to avoid picking qty)\nMONEY_RE = re.compile(r\"(?<![\\d.,])(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})+\\.\\d{2}|\\d+\\.\\d{2})(?![\\d.,])\")\n\n# Dates: DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY or DD/MM/YY (handles 1- or 2-digit day/month)\nDATE_RE = re.compile(r\"(\\b\\d{1,2})[/-](\\d{1,2})[/-](\\d{2,4}\\b)\")\n\n\ndef ocr_text(path: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Run OCR with light preprocessing to improve reliability.\"\"\"\n    img = Image.open(path)\n    gray = ImageOps.grayscale(img)\n    enhanced = ImageOps.autocontrast(gray)\n    # Default PSM 3 (fully automatic) works well for most receipts\n    text = pytesseract.image_to_string(enhanced)\n    # If result looks sparse, retry with psm 6 (uniform block)\n    if len(text.strip()) < 50:\n        text = pytesseract.image_to_string(enhanced, config=\"--psm 6\")\n    return text\n\n\ndef extract_date(text: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the first plausible date in ISO format.\"\"\"\n    for m in DATE_RE.finditer(text):\n        d, mo, y = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)\n        day, month = int(d), int(mo)\n        if len(y) == 2:\n            year = 2000 + int(y)\n        else:\n            year = int(y)\n        if 1 <= day <= 31 and 1 <= month <= 12 and 2000 <= year <= 2099:\n            return f\"{year:04d}-{month:02d}-{day:02d}\"\n    return None\n\n\ndef _is_excluded(line_upper: str, keyword: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Return True if line contains any exclusion keyword not implied by the matched keyword.\"\"\"\n    for ex in EXCLUSION_KEYWORDS:\n        if ex in line_upper and ex not in keyword:\n            # Allow \"TOTAL\" line that also contains \"GST\" like \"Total Sales (Inclusive of GST)\".\n            # These lines usually hold the final total, so only exclude if ex term is standalone.\n            # We treat SUBTOTAL/SUB TOTAL/CHANGE/DISCOUNT/TAX/GST/SST/CASH TENDERED as hard exclusions.\n            return True\n    return False\n\n\ndef _last_money(line: str) -> str | None:\n    nums = MONEY_RE.findall(line)\n    return nums[-1] if nums else None\n\n\ndef extract_total(text: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Find the receipt total amount using priority keyword lookup.\n\n    Lines matching higher-priority groups are preferred. Lines containing\n    exclusion keywords (unless the exclusion term is part of the keyword\n    itself, e.g. a plain TOTAL on a 'Total Sales (Inclusive of GST)' line)\n    are skipped.\n    \"\"\"\n    lines = text.splitlines()\n    upper_lines = [ln.upper() for ln in lines]\n\n    for group in KEYWORD_GROUPS:\n        best = None  # (priority_within_group, idx, value)\n        for i, up in enumerate(upper_lines):\n            for kw in group:\n                if kw not in up:\n                    continue\n                # Skip lines where another exclusion keyword appears that\n                # isn't part of the matched keyword string.\n                if _is_excluded(up, kw):\n                    continue\n                val = _last_money(lines[i])\n                if val is None:\n                    # Fallback: look at next non-empty line\n                    for j in range(i + 1, min(i + 3, len(lines))):\n                        if lines[j].strip():\n                            val = _last_money(lines[j])\n                            if val is not None:\n                                break\n                if val is not None:\n                    best = (i, val)\n                    break  # take first keyword match in this line\n            if best is not None:\n                break\n        if best is not None:\n            # Normalise: strip commas, keep two decimals\n            v = best[1].replace(\",\", \"\")\n            # Ensure two decimals\n            if \".\" in v:\n                int_part, dec_part = v.split(\".\")\n                dec_part = (dec_part + \"00\")[:2]\n                return f\"{int_part}.{dec_part}\"\n            return f\"{v}.00\"\n    return None\n\n\ndef main():\n    wb = Workbook()\n    ws = wb.active\n    ws.title = \"results\"\n    ws.append([\"filename\", \"date\", \"total_amount\"])\n\n    for fname in sorted(os.listdir(IMG_DIR)):\n        if not fname.lower().endswith((\".jpg\", \".jpeg\", \".png\")):\n            continue\n        text = ocr_text(os.path.join(IMG_DIR, fname))\n        date = extract_date(text)\n        total = extract_total(text)\n        ws.append([fname, date, total])\n        print(f\"{fname}: date={date}, total={total}\")\n\n    wb.save(OUT_PATH)\n    print(f\"\\nWrote {OUT_PATH}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"}","name":"file_editor"},"id":"toolu_01XPTPaoCK4FiuG7Kfs3aEht","index":0,"type":"function"}]},"message_id":"train-r01-b04-a01:m0126"}
